files.content:
// run
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"
)

func main() {
	var a, b runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&a)
	sink := make([][]byte, 0, 256)
	for i := 0; i < 256; i++ {
		sink = append(sink, make([]byte, 1024))
	}
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&b)
	fmt.Println("allocated more:", b.TotalAlloc > a.TotalAlloc)
	fmt.Println("mallocs counted:", b.Mallocs > a.Mallocs)
	fmt.Println("live heap grew:", b.HeapAlloc > a.HeapAlloc)
	runtime.GC()
	var c runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&c)
	fmt.Println("gc counted:", c.NumGC > a.NumGC)
	fmt.Println("frees counted:", c.Frees >= a.Frees)
	fmt.Println("kept:", len(sink))
}

want.out:
allocated more: true
mallocs counted: true
live heap grew: true
gc counted: true
frees counted: true
kept: 256
